scope: Installed client targeted mechanics review, not complete game decompilation

validation.instructionStreams: Every decoded function reserializes byte-for-byte and matches reported VM size.
validation.wholeAssets: Not roundtrip validated. Parsed exports lose empty-header bytes on whole-asset reserialization; no files written to game installation.
validation.parser: UAssetAPI 7ecaebdf9365798a74ea4ba03af0ee66f56dbfde; local net8 compatibility and empty-property-header handling changes; UE5.4 serialization profile. Profile does not prove installed engine release.
validation.limits: Raw exports retained undecoded; property schemas, inherited defaults and native functions remain unresolved. Source decoding does not establish server parity.

findings.subject: Ashbringer
findings.status: runtime branch traced; native helper contract still open
findings.finding: BasicDamage events bypass the ability-instance branch and process currently active non-ultimate cooldown effects on each qualifying event. Nonbasic events use a UniqueInstances array. On-hit and critical-damage paths exclude cleave. Reduction incorporates EventDataFloat and a critical multiplier.
findings.impact: The diagnostic replay one-reduction-per-receiving-cooldown rule is contradicted by the basic-damage branch. Production still omits this passive.
findings.open: Trace native event payload scaling and ReduceGameplayEffectDurationRemainingByPercent before claiming exact reduction amount. Array_AddUnique now has a static native trace: duplicate identities return -1 (noxia-review.json); Ashbringer call-site and identity lifecycle still require validation.

findings.subject: Knell
findings.status: runtime arithmetic and serialized curve bindings traced; native overrides and effect defaults unresolved
findings.finding: Rejects ProcDamage and requires a hero target. Applies one stack, or four with Peal buff. Computes ShredPerStack = GetValueAtLevel(Shred,0) + GetValueAtLevel(ShredPerLevel,0) * actorLevel. Replaces target shred effect and passes 1-stackCount*ShredPerStack for armor and magic resist. Steal uses modified effect magnitude and post-application target attributes, tracked by target.
findings.impact: Prior 17.6% level-13 statement from curve interpolation alone is not runtime-verified. If the default bindings use the named curves with endpoint clamping at zero, arithmetic would instead yield 18.4%; do not promote that conditional value yet.
findings.open: Shred/ShredPerLevel/StealModifier now have exact serialized curve bindings. Trace native curve-table override selection, virtual curve evaluation and GetModifiedAttributeMagnitudeForHandle semantics; verify stacking, refresh and expiry settings. See native-curve-helper-review.json.

findings.subject: Solaris
findings.status: runtime trigger and healing paths traced
findings.finding: Registers an ability-commit listener. Damage handler checks TriggersOnHit plus Solaris stacks; its own damage-tagged events take a separate healing path using event damage magnitude times HealingPercent.
findings.impact: Production generic on-ability-hit implementation is not faithful. Diagnostic healing is closer but needs event ordering and defaults verified.
findings.open: Decode empowerment duration/cooldown/defaults; trace crit handling in damage effect and native damage executor.

findings.subject: Kira Purge
findings.finding: Iterates actors in range, filters target eligibility, applies ultimate damage effect, then delays 0.16666699945926666 seconds before repeating.
findings.impact: Aggregate ultimate damage hides repeated events that may interact with stacks and procs.
findings.open: Verify activation/animation first-hit timing, cancellation and last-hit boundary; decode per-tick damage defaults. Do not infer exact tick count solely from duration/interval.

findings.subject: Ruination
findings.status: runtime calculation and refresh filtering recovered
findings.finding: Initial per-application damage calculation uses target current/max mana, clamps the total drain, divides by Duration*2, applies a minimum of 1 before DamageModifier. Refresh path tests damage tags and excludes basic, magical-basic, cleave, item and proc tags.
findings.impact: Uniform continuous drain plus refresh-on-every-ability is an approximation, not the recovered behavior.
findings.open: Decode effect period, mana modifier, native refresh contract, and zero-mana edge case before replacing model.
